about_blocks.text: Paradise Valley Healing Center is located on 10 stunning acres close to the Cheakamus River. The rehab facility is located only one hour north of Vancouver, British Columbia. Formerly known as Chopra Addiction and Wellness Center, Paradise Valley is dedicated to addressing a broad range of addictive behaviors like depression, anxiety, and psychological trauma using a holistic approach. Paradise Valley offers 2,4, and 6 week wellness programs that provide care for the whole body, mind, and spirit.

about_blocks.text: Paradise Valley provides individual counseling and group therapy to do deep work with clients. The healing process combines the most cutting-edge Western medicine with Eastern healing arts. Ayurvedic services such as yoga, meditation, massage therapy, acupuncture, and vegetarian cuisine are available to guests. The facility accommodates a maximum of 9 residential guests, providing a high degree of personal care and attention. Additionally, the rehab center urges family members to take part in the healing and recovery process.

about_blocks.text: The setting of Paradise Valley is equally as important as the holistic treatment they provide. The peace and tranquility of the river and mountains in the vicinity add to the therapeutic effect. The cozy home has gender-specific accommodations and guests share a bedroom furnished with single beds. Other common areas in the house include a lounge with a fireplace and a large living room. The Center offers a true holistic program with its stunning surroundings, promoting relaxation and inner healing.

about_blocks.text: Paradise Valley Healing Center offers a range of benefits to people on the journey to healing and recovery. The facility’s holistic approach helps address emotional, physical, and psychological issues. Ayurvedic services, yoga, meditation, and acupuncture are some of the services that provide support in this regard. The small size of the facility allows for a more intimate and personalized care approach, while family members are involved in the process, and the nurturing environment of the surrounding nature eases the healing process.

about_blocks.text: Paradise Valley Healing Center offers a customized, individualized, and highly intensive program that is tailored to meet the specific needs of each guest. Our team of highly qualified and experienced therapists and addiction specialists provides personalized care and support to ensure that each guest receives the most effective treatment possible. Our program includes a range of evidence-based therapies, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical behavior therapy, and other scientifically proven modalities.

about_blocks.text: At Paradise Valley Healing Center, we aim to create a healing environment that fosters self-awareness and promotes self-discovery through various activities such as art therapy, equine therapy, and outdoor activities. Our objective is to help guests develop deeper connections with themselves and others, and find meaning and purpose in life. Our comprehensive approach to addiction and trauma treatment, combined with our serene location and experienced staff, make Paradise Valley Healing Center one of the premier rehabilitation centers in Canada.
